payload.comparison_population: WT animals in an allergen-induced asthma model
payload.supporting_quote: mice lacking Arg2 had greater Th2 inflammation than WT mice, as indicated by higher levels of pSTAT6, IL-13, IL-17, eotaxin, and eosinophils

payload.comparison_population: control mice in an ovalbumin-induced asthma model
payload.supporting_quote: OVA-induced peribronchial inflammation and bronchoalveolar lavage fluid (BALF) levels of the Th2 cytokine IL-13 were significantly decreased in the CaMKIIδ knockouts.

payload.comparison_population: mice with ovalbumin-induced allergic asthma (control group) in a treatment study
payload.symptoms: airway inflammation, mucus production, airway hyperresponsiveness
payload.supporting_quote: treatment with ZM decreased the inflammatory cell count in bronchoalveolar lavage fluid from the mice, and reduced the expression of interleukin (IL)‑4, IL‑5, IL‑13, eotaxin and immunoglobulin E.
